doc: A game picture to look at closely: the map interfaces and the treasure map of the items screen. texture/uv name the picture in the player's game files (ui-game-image); base [w, h] is the size the game measures it in, view [x0, y0, x1, y1] the part shown first, markers [{texture, uv?, x, y, w, h}] the game's pictures on it (centre and size in base units). Pan with one finger, pinch or the zoom buttons; a tap reports `point x,y` in base units (behaviour panzoom). room names the layout around the view (a sheet open beside it): a change refits the view once the layout has run.
